title: PixelWind
body:
Archived - Dear fellow players, 8 months have passed since the realese of this Modpack, and many things have changed since then. Better mods and alternatives that make the game even smoother with bigger FPS boost! You can still download the Modpack, but it wont receive any updates. Thank you for your support.

## PixelWind
**Experience Minecraft like never before with the Ultimate FPS Boost Modpack, designed specifically for the best performance on Fabric!** Optimized for smooth gameplay, this modpack enhances frame rates, reduces lag, and improves overall game stability without compromising on the vanilla feel. Perfect for players who want lightning-fast performance on any machine. Whether you're exploring vast worlds or engaging in fast-paced combat, this modpack ensures your game runs as efficiently as possible! Having a low-end laptop or PC, especially when playing Minecraft, can lead to fps drops, memory instability and much more, while using this modpack with **numerous Performance Mods** ensures you that you are going to get the most out of your system!

Everything is highly customizable, from the animations down to the light updates!

**WARNING**; Switching everything off or messing with settings **can break the game!** If you don't know what you are doing, **don't mess around** with the advanced features! Also, there are some options that make the game look awfull, and don't give a good amount of fps, so consider watching a video explaining how all settings work if you want the best peformance with medium-style graphics.
